upstream.title: A first high-quality vector data of buildings in East Asian countries based on a comprehensive large-scale mapping framework

source.geometryMeaning: roofprint; ground occupancy, current use and entrances are not established
source.changes: Bounded area extraction. Source coordinates and GERS IDs retained; output ring order normalized. Display heights are separate cartographic proxies.

display.basis: The surrounding residential compound uses one common illustrative main volume and low ancillary roof volumes. The area/width split controls only visual scale, not building use or storey count. No extra roof structures or windows are inferred.
display.heightContext: Public listings describe six-storey residences in this compound; they do not identify every footprint or establish measured height.
